summary: Ambitious Impact's estimate for a new charity that distributes and maintains oxygen concentrators and pulse oximeters so hospitals can treat childhood pneumonia, modelled for Nigeria. The idea Oxygen Access Project was founded to run. A re-implementation of the 2024 updated CEA in AIM's spreadsheet, which AIM marks as superseding the 2023 report's model, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: about $173 per DALY averted (the 2023 report quoted $38 to $79).

theoretical.reason: Ambitious Impact's estimate of the idea, written before the charity existed; not based on the charity's own results.
theoretical.runs: Oxygen Access Project provides hospitals with oximeters, oxygen concentrators, maintenance and power (registered February 2025 for work in Nigeria).
